primaryWitnesses.text: They arose out of Midian and came to Paran; and they took men with them out of Paran, and they came to Egypt, to Pharaoh king of Egypt, who gave him a house, and appointed him food, and gave him land.

wikipediaRead.locator: Lead and Biblical section, lines 131–151; geographical arguments lines 152–160
wikipediaRead.support: The lead identifies the Wilderness of Paran as a biblical location and says it was a refuge for David; line 151 states David went there after Samuel’s death. The geography section presents competing locations.
